proved_locally: events form an exact predecessor chain with unique identities and monotonic time
worker acceptance and completion require the R70 target cell as actor
completion persists only a content-free result receipt digest
failure persists a bounded code and evidence digest rather than prose
retryable failure can request a linked retry only before attempt five
the fifth retryable failure must dead-letter
dead-letter recovery is an explicit operator request followed by a linked replacement dispatch
closed state, automatic terminal state and operator attention are separate facts
unexpected fields such as a raw provider handle are rejected
unproved: atomic event insertion and aggregate projection
bounded_claim: R71 proves the pure lifecycle reducer and recovery semantics. It persists, sends, alerts and recovers nothing.
next_gate: Persist R70 dispatches and R71 events append-only in local PostgreSQL with exact replay, transition locking and content-free projections.
